name: Treasure Hunt Simulator
desc:
Welcome to Treasure Hunt Simulator (THS)! Dig your way through the dig site looking for buried treasure! Once you find some use your coins to upgrade your shovel, backpack, pets and more! 

Join "Treasure Hunt Simulator Fans" group for "Fan" tag and +10% extra money when you sell sand!
